subject: How to solve the sec-WebSocket-Protocol error in Chrome 30.0.1599.66 m

messages.author: 4f3a300f6b3a3a4d
messages.subject: How to solve the sec-WebSocket-Protocol error in Chrome 30.0.1599.66 m
parts:
Simply remove the 'shiny' sub-protocol in shini.js in line 453.

Before the change:

      var createSocketFunc = exports.createSocket || function() {
        var ws = new WebSocket('ws://' + window.location.host, 'shiny');
        ws.binaryType = 'arraybuffer';
        return ws;
      };

After the change:

      var createSocketFunc = exports.createSocket || function() {
        var ws = new WebSocket('ws://' + window.location.host);
        ws.binaryType = 'arraybuffer';
        return ws;
      };

It works perfectly for me.

parts: Hi, what version of Shiny are you using? As of version 0.7.0, this was the code:

https://github.com/rstudio/shiny/blob/v/0/7/0/inst/www/shared/shiny.js#L463

(There have been more modifications to that function in the development version of Shiny.)
